scenarios.label: WAN link unavailable
scenarios.detail: The gateway keeps accepting bounded local sensor and control events.
scenarios.operatorNote: Protect the local control invariant first, then drain the backlog without saturating the returning link.

scenarios.label: Store isolated from region
scenarios.detail: Sales and inventory reservations continue under a local allocation.
scenarios.localAuthority: Only preallocated inventory may be promised
scenarios.operatorNote: Reconciliation needs business rules because both sides may have changed the same inventory fact.

scenarios.label: Gateway restarts mid-sync
scenarios.detail: Acknowledgements are uncertain and part of the upload is retried.
scenarios.localAuthority: Durable local log resumes after restart
scenarios.operatorNote: Stable event identities and checkpoints must make replay safe after an ambiguous acknowledgement.

policies.label: Versioned domain merge
policies.detail: Deduplicate by event ID and resolve concurrent facts with an explicit domain rule.
policies.risk: Requires version metadata and a merge rule for every mutable fact.

policies.label: Quarantine conflicts
policies.detail: Replay non-conflicting events and hold ambiguous facts for operator review.
policies.risk: Preserves evidence but delays the affected business workflow.

policies.label: Cloud state always wins
policies.detail: Discard conflicting local intent when the node reconnects.
policies.risk: Simple convergence can erase valid actions that users already observed locally.

policies.label: Blind append and retry
policies.detail: Upload every record again without a stable idempotency key.
policies.risk: Ambiguous retries become duplicate business effects and conflicts remain unresolved.
